text:
alex: Quick question — PR #2741 (orders schema migration) is ready from my side but CI backlog is ~2h. There's a deploy freeze starting Wed 03:00 UTC for the DB migration blackout. Do we hold until after the freeze or try to get this in before? If we need to land before freeze I can ask for a rebase slot. Ping @maddy for final review.

maddy: looked through, left two tiny comments (naming + test message). not blocking. can approve once addressed.

sam: CI is showing a flaky e2e on mac-legacy, looks unrelated to schema but it blocks green. i'd rerun the failing job. @ci-bot can you rerun job-437?

ci-bot: CI: job-437 rerun requested by sam — queued. est start ~30m. you can check queue at https://ci.internal.redwood/job/437 :robot_face: 

julie: release note: if it's not merged by 02:30 UTC we'll hold it to avoid touching the DB during the blackout. prefer landing after freeze unless you can split the migration to a non-blocking change. also prefer no big rollback risk during blackout.

alex: thanks — I'm inclined to split this into two smaller PRs so we can land the non-blocking part before the freeze and the migration step after. splitting would avoid long lock and reduce rollback blast radius. thinking: PR A = add new columns nullable + feature flag; PR B = backfill + migrate and flip flag.

maddy: that sounds much safer. smaller PR A can be fast-tracked through CI. please include the feature-flag toggle in PR A so we can ship safely.

sam: agree. if you split, we can land PR A before the 02:30 cutoff; PR B can go into the regular post-freeze window and request canary. i'll watch the CI queue and ping for reruns.

alex: ok i'll open two PRs in ~20m. canceling rebase slot request for now. command I'll use: `gh pr create --base main --head alex/schema-part-a --title "orders: add nullable columns behind flag"` — then follow with PR B.

devops-oncall: FYI if you do need an emergency post-freeze migration we need a 2h runway and a scheduled maintenance window. for pre-freeze lands we need approvals and CI green before 02:30. ping me if that changes.

alex: got it, will proceed with split. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
